title: An ALMA Survey of Sub-millimeter Galaxies in the Extended Chandra Deep Field South: Sub-millimeter Properties of Color-selected Galaxies
question: What are the sub-mm (344 GHz) properties, dust SEDs and SFRs of optical/NIR color-selected galaxies (K-selected, sBzK, ERO, DRG) in ALESS fields, as measured by stacking ALMA data?

what.value: Photometric catalog, SED fits and photometric redshifts of ECDFS

evidence.quote: We base our analysis on the photometric catalog by (cite: simpson14)
We use the deblended SPIRE maps described in (cite: swinbank14).

evidence.loc: 5.3 Comparison with previous results at 870 um
evidence.quote: Table [1](#tab_results) (bottom) reports the stacked fluxes obtained in G10 for their sub-mm faint sample

recipe.method: Color/magnitude cuts on MUSYC catalog: K_Vega<20, sBzK, ERO, DRG
key_parameters: only sources within 10.4'' (1.2x primary beam radius) of pointing centre

recipe.method: Cut stamps, primary-beam correct, weighted average (weights = inverse square of PB correction); also median stacks
key_parameters: flux cuts of 3.6, 1.8, 1.2 mJy; z>1 subsample; smoothing to 1.6'' circular beam test
assumptions: all maps have same depth within ~20%

recipe.method: Stack N random positions per sample, 50 iterations; rms of stacked fluxes = noise

recipe.goal: Stack SPIRE maps and fit dust SED, derive L_IR and SFR
recipe.method: Stack deblended SPIRE residual maps at z>1; fit modified blackbody; integrate 8-1000 um; SFR from Genzel+10 relation

recipe.goal: Test ALESS-field bias with radio stacks, clustering and redshift distributions
recipe.method: KS tests, Monte-Carlo clustering, 1.4 GHz median stacks, bootstrapping of field medians
Average SFR x number of galaxies / comoving volume (34000 Mpc^3, 7.0 arcmin^2, 1<z<2.6), scaled down by ALESS radio excess

evidence.quote: We find $\beta=1.6$ and $T_{\rm dust}\approx 30$ K in all the cases.

not_stated_but_needed: CASA version and calibration details (in Hodge et al. 2013)
Calibrated ALESS image products/primary beam models used
Exact positions of pointings and catalog cross-match details
Fitting method/priors for the modified blackbody and how SPIRE+344 GHz points were weighted
Redshifts used for each galaxy in SED fits
Radio stacking details (map weighting, median stack procedure)
Procedure for rescaling SFRD by ALESS excess
missing_for_reproduction: Calibrated ALESS maps and Simpson et al. catalog needed
score_reason: Stacking recipe clear and data public, but inputs from companion papers and fitting details missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, simple stacking recipe, numeric results in tables; depends on companion catalogs.
